purpose: The Fedora 44 repository metadata and key the fedora44-server-amd64 profile is built from. fedora-repo-pinned.sh refuses a repository whose repomd.xml no longer has the sha256 recorded here, and a key file whose sha256 differs.
basis: Each repomd.xml was read by an anonymous HTTPS GET at the recorded time; the primary metadata it names was retained and verified against its checksum and open-checksum. Fedora does not sign repomd.xml (repodata/repomd.xml.asc returned 404 on both trees at 2026-09-27T10:08:35Z), so the sha256 is what binds the metadata; every package is checked against the key. The releases tree is fixed after the release; the updates tree keeps only current builds, so its pin holds until the next updates push and is then re-pinned, never loosened.

key.basis: The file fedora-gpg-keys-44-2.noarch (updates primary) installs, byte-equal to https://src.fedoraproject.org/rpms/fedora-repos/raw/f44/f/RPM-GPG-KEY-fedora-44-primary; its fingerprint is the one https://fedoraproject.org/security/ lists for Fedora 44 (read 2026-09-27T10:04:20Z).
